page.events.board.title: Uhlu lwemicimbi
page.events.empty.body: Yiba owokuqala ukwabelana ngemibukiso, imincintiswano, imicimbi yabalandeli, noma imihlangano yabadali. Faka usuku, indawo, nendlela yokujoyina.
page.events.empty.title: Azikho okuthunyelwe kwemicimbi okwamanje
page.events.guide.1.body: Amaphromoshini nemivuzo eqhutshwa yi-ToonStudio ngqo imenyezelwa lapha kuqala.
page.events.guide.1.title: Hlola imicimbi esemthethweni
page.events.guide.2.body: Imicimbi ezovalwa maduze ibonisa ibheji le-D-day elikhanyayo. Joyina ngaphambi kokuba iphele.
page.events.guide.2.title: Buka izinsuku zokugcina
page.events.guide.3.body: Ungathumeli ukuhwebelana kwamathikithi noma ulwazi lokuxhumana lomuntu siqu esidlangalaleni — sebenzisa iziteshi ezisemthethweni esikhundleni salokho.
page.events.guide.3.title: Bamba iqhaza ngokuphepha
page.events.guide.title: Umhlahlandlela wemicimbi
page.events.hero.lede: Hlola izinzuzo zokuvulwa kwe-beta ye-ToonStudio, imivuzo yabadali, nemicimbi ezayo.
page.events.hero.title: Ibhodi lemicimbi
